sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "author_name" TEXT NULL, "author_url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "original_file_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "space_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "processing_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "renditions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NULL, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((content IS NULL) <> (relative_path IS NULL)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (name COLLATE NOCASE));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_tags" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "relations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "to_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (from_item_id, to_item_id, kind), CHECK (from_item_id <> to_item_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "highlights" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rendition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES renditions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "excerpt" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_offset > start_offset), CHECK (start_offset >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flashcards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "front" TEXT NOT NULL, "back" TEXT NOT NULL, "ease_factor" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_reviewed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "is_user" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_user" IN (0, 1)), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "sources_json" TEXT NULL, "attachments_json" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_definitions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text', "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (name COLLATE NOCASE));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_values" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "number_value" REAL NULL, "date_from_year" INTEGER NULL, "date_from_month" INTEGER NULL, "date_from_day" INTEGER NULL, "date_to_year" INTEGER NULL, "date_to_month" INTEGER NULL, "date_to_day" INTEGER NULL, "date_precision" TEXT NULL, "date_is_circa" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("date_is_circa" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (definition_id, value COLLATE NOCASE));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_property_values" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "property_value_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_values (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "property_value_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "property_value_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_values (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES property_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (definition_id, alias COLLATE NOCASE));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_url" TEXT NULL, "author_name" TEXT NULL, "author_url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_blob_path" TEXT NULL, "full_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "dedup_hash" TEXT NULL, "simhash" TEXT NULL, "processing_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "processing_error" TEXT NULL, "processing_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "note_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "maturity" TEXT NOT NULL, "dedup_hash" TEXT NULL, "simhash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chunks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "char_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "char_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ms" INTEGER NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NULL, "page_number" INTEGER NULL, "heading_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE (item_id, seq));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "embeddings" ("chunk_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chunks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "vector" BLOB NOT NULL, "model_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("chunk_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_issues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "migration" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suggestions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merged_provenances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "author_name" TEXT NULL, "author_url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "merged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_items_created_at ON items (created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_items_updated_at ON items (updated_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_relations_to ON relations (to_item_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_flashcards_item ON flashcards (item_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_flashcards_due_at ON flashcards (due_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_mode ON conversations (mode)
CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_updated_at ON conversations (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_messages_conversation ON chat_messages (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_property_values_definition ON property_values (definition_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_item_property_values_value ON item_property_values (property_value_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_property_aliases_value ON property_aliases (property_value_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_entries_state_kind ON item (state, kind)
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_entries_kind_updated ON item (kind, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_sources_content_hash ON source (content_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_sources_dedup_hash ON source (dedup_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_sources_processing_status ON source (processing_status)
CREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_notes_dedup_hash ON note (dedup_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_chunks_item_seq ON chunks (item_id, seq)
CREATE INDEX idx_chunks_item_start_ms ON chunks (item_id, start_ms)
CREATE INDEX idx_suggestions_target_status ON suggestions (target_item_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_merged_provenances_item ON merged_provenances (item_id)
